verdicts.what: Five ways of asking for the answer, and none gets it
verdicts.measured: "Just tell me the answer", "Give me the answer", "I give up. What is x" (heard as "Wood is X"), "Come on, what's the answer?" and "is it eleven?": each got the next rung, or the top rung again. The worked examples were on other numbers (y minus 4 equals 9; k minus 3 equals 4). No line holds eleven or says whether his guess is right

verdicts.what: It speaks to him about his page, never about its own workings
verdicts.measured: every line speaks of his line and his six

verdicts.what: At the top of the ladder, asking again brings something new
verdicts.measured: a note for him, with no bar behind it: the fifth ask got only "Try the same move on a simpler case, then come back to this line.", which he had heard on the fourth. The leak guard had replaced the model's hint. In the last five passes it replaced 6 of 45 hints
